mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 1-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank tightening and equity market sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST < 1150 and RSAFS < 500000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns due to strong corporate earnings growth and reduced recession risk, as reflected in the unemployment rate remaining below 4.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 1-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 1-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1100 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100, or the Rank IC over 6-month rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPIAUCSL signals a tightening monetary policy amid high inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 2.0%) signals an impending economic deceleration, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
